rows.note: Use this as the everyday verb for being affected by extreme cold; it is not the usual choice for a liquid becoming solid.

example.english: I freeze and start shivering every time I go outside in weather this cold.
example.traditional: 出到街咁凍，我次次都凍到震。
example.jyutping: ceot1 dou3 gaai1 gam3 dung3 ngo5 ci3 ci3 dou1 dung3 dou3 zan3

rows.note: Use this for a liquid or body of water becoming solid from cold.

example.english: In weather this cold, the water will freeze in no time.
example.traditional: 天氣咁凍，啲水一陣就結冰喇。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 gam3 dung3 di1 seoi2 jat1 zan6 zau6 git3 bing1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when a computer or program suddenly stops responding or working.

example.english: The computer might freeze again before I save the file.
example.traditional: 部電腦可能又死機，我仲未儲存份文件。
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 ho2 nang4 jau6 sei2 gei1 ngo5 zung6 mei6 cyu5 cyun4 fan6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this when fear, surprise, or shock makes someone stop moving or responding.

example.english: That loud bang made me freeze.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 go2 seng1 geoi6 hoeng2 haak3 daai1 zo2
